notes: PLACEHOLDER rig file. rig_id names the NEW rig (ROSbot XL + ZED 2i + RPLIDAR S3, PLAN.md Sec 0), but no metrology chain for that rig exists in this repo yet -- delta_z_chain terms, pitch_deg, roll_deg and attitude_instrument are all illustrative placeholders (measurement_status=PLACEHOLDER, every delta_z_chain entry carries placeholder=true). delta_z_m=0.045 is NOT derived from delta_z_chain (which sums to 0.0 while every term is a placeholder) -- it is an illustrative default matching PLAN.md Sec 1.3's own worked example and the OLD (STL-19P) rig's rough manual z_down=-0.045 note in cam_lidar_2d_icp.py::validate_against_manual_rig_geometry, kept only so Phase 0/1 diagnostics have a plausible non-zero delta_z to exercise the row-geometry math and the projection overlay before real metrology exists. Sign convention (PLAN.md Sec 1.2): delta_z_m is the height of the LiDAR scan plane above the rectified left camera optical centre in frame R, positive = LiDAR higher than camera. Do not use this file's numeric values for anything beyond Phase 0/1 development diagnostics -- rig.load_rig() refuses (raises RuntimeError) to load this file unless the caller explicitly passes allow_placeholder=True, and any such call must print a loud warning banner (see rig.warn_if_placeholder).
